description: Source code for simple utility functions related to disk cache in Chromium, including hash key conversions, filename generation, size calculations, and CRC32 checksum functions.

methods.name: ConvertEntryHashKeyToHexString
methods.description: Converts a uint64 hash key to a hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: GetEntryHashKeyAsHexString
methods.description: Returns the hexadecimal string representation of the hash key for a given string key.

methods.name: GetEntryHashKeyFromHexString
methods.description: Parses a hex string to retrieve the corresponding uint64 hash key.

methods.name: GetEntryHashKey
methods.description: Computes a hash key from a string using SHA1 and extracting a uint64.

methods.name: GetFilenameFromEntryFileKeyAndFileIndex
methods.description: Generates filename from entry file key and file index.

methods.name: GetSparseFilenameFromEntryFileKey
methods.description: Generates sparse filename from entry file key.

methods.name: GetFilenameFromKeyAndFileIndex
methods.description: Generates filename from key and file index.

methods.name: GetHeaderSize
methods.description: Calculates header size based on key length.

methods.name: GetDataSizeFromFileSize
methods.description: Calculates data size from total file size and key length.

methods.name: GetFileSizeFromDataSize
methods.description: Calculates total file size from data size and key length.

methods.name: GetFileIndexFromStreamIndex
methods.description: Maps stream index to file index.

methods.name: IncrementalCrc32
methods.description: Updates CRC32 checksum with additional data.
